page.layout: Two printed columns of Hebrew-Latin word list, left column then right column, both on one printed page. Running head at top centre. Page number at top right. Catchword and gathering signature at the foot of the right column.

main_text.l: אֶיחַל exspectabo, sperabo, 1. sing. fut. Piel, Rad. יָחַל.
אֵיכְכָה quomodo, אֵיכֹה ubinam, particulae Adv. Rad. אֵךְ quomodo.
אַיֵּה ubi tu? אַיּוֹ ubi ille? אַיִם ubi illi? part. Adv. aff. à part. Rad. אַיֵּה vel אֵיָּה.
אֵילוּת fortitudo, אַיִל aries, אַיִל planicies, אֵילִים arietes, אֵילָה, אֵילָת cerva, &c. sing. & pl. fæm. & m. No. Rad. אֵיל fortitudo.
אֵילִיל ejulabo, וְאֵילִילָה & ejulabo, 1. sing. fut. Hiph. parag. Rad. יָלַל.
אֵילְכָה ibo, 1. f. fut. Kal, parag. Rad. יָלַךְ.
אֵילָמוֹ vestibula ejus, pl. m. aff. No. sing. אֵילָם vestibulum, Rad. אָלַם obmutescere.
אֵימָה terrifica, אֵימָה, אֵימַת formido, אֵימִים, gigantes, &c. No. sing. fæm. & pl. masc. Rad. [?]
וְאֵימְנָה & dexteram petam, vel אֵימְנָה, 1. sing. fut. Hiph. parag. Rad. יָמִן.
אֵינְךָ non illi, אֵינֶנּוּ non tu, מֵאֵין, בְּאֵין absque, &c. præf. & aff. cum part. Rad. אַיִן non, nihil, nullus.
אִין insulæ, No. pl. masc. à sing. masc. No. Rad. אִי insula.
אֵינָק sugam, 1. sing. fut. Kal, R. יָנַק.
אֵיצַר castigabo, 1. sing. fut. Piel, Rad. יָסַר.
אֵיסִירֵם castigabo eos, 1. sing. fut. Hiph. affix. Rad. יָסַר.
אֵיפָה epha, f. fæm. constr. No. R. אֵיפָה.
אֵיצָה consulam, הָ consulam tibi, 1. sing. fut. Kal, parag. & affix. Rad. יָעַן.

page.notes: No marginal notes. The Hebrew vowel points and dagesh are copied as far as legible at this scan resolution; the Hebrew root of the entry "אֵימָה" and similar forms with dense points may differ in detail. The entry at the head of the right column reads "vel אֵים" and the Rad. after "gigantes" is partly cut off at the column edge, hence [?]. The Greek-free running head reads "א '" with the apostrophe as printed.
